quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 report: Q3 revenue RMB 631,864,294.37, up 134.61% year over year, and Q3 net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 101,728,838.83, up 2,642.24%; nine-month revenue RMB 1,363,666,355.09, up 70.71%, and nine-month net profit RMB 175,998,728.35, up 869.79%.

quarterly_data.quarter: Yunnan Germanium quarterly report: 2026 Q3 Report (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 report, the company's explanation: sharply higher demand from AI data centers and optical communications raised sales volume of indium phosphide and other compound semiconductor materials, and the InP average selling price rose with market supply and demand; deliveries under earlier contracts lifted material-grade germanium volume and infrared lens orders rose; contract liabilities rose to RMB 198,156,572.02 from RMB 1,589,450.06, mainly InP and other product prepayments received, and prepayments for raw materials rose 891.36% to RMB 347,791,182.51; construction in progress rose 145.67% to RMB 240,722,569.06, mainly for the germanium wafer project for space solar cells and the high-quality gallium arsenide project.
